findings: incremental apply reproduces the clean-rebuild dataset byte-identically for every corpus-restoring scenario
canonical rows are append-only; ARTIFACT_REMOVED is a delta-level semantic transition (rows retained)
limitations: observations are derived from the G2-C dataset (decompile round-trip) rather than fresh captures
G and I2 use synthetic observation content (no real CNMV event exists for them in the frozen corpus)
ARTIFACT_REMOVED does not mark current-source availability in V1 — that would be a schema addition (V2)
